request.text_prompt: Create original cold cinematic science-fiction game audio, approximately 1.2 seconds. A laser penetrates a ship hull: hot energy contact, sizzling metal rupture and short decay. Fine piercing crack, molten steel sizzle and one small ringing fragment. One self-contained event or specified short sequence; clear attack, natural decay, quiet clean tail; no abrupt truncation or long dead air. No vocals, singing, humming, speech, narration, lyrics or spoken prompt. No clipping, harsh distortion or unrelated scene sounds. No music, melody or soundtrack.
